gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-hind: Tilt Neon flares its c terminals and draws every stroke like glowing tube. Hind follows in a sans where lowercase nearly matches the capitals, steady and unfussy, which gives the loud heading something quiet to lean on.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tight, with big counters in tall lowercase and curves that never quite close. Wallpoet above it is stencil-cut and high-rising, so the page stays punchy.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-alpino: Warnes stretches out wide, its ink strokes tapering away before they touch, all at one weight. And Alpino sits beneath it, tall and cozy, with tight spacing and curve endings kept well apart.
gen-megrim-fs-alpino: Alpino reads tall and casual, with tight spacing and curve endings that stay well apart from each other. Shrink Megrim, and its thin angular lines would nearly vanish.
gen-syne-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Syne draws a constant stripe of ink with no pinched curves, and its x-height climbs nearly to cap height. Noto Serif Hentaigana answers with subtle stroke modulation and open jaws on every curve, refined and traditional.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cascadia-code: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters with a pronounced x-height. Cascadia Code follows in a plain sans with wire-like monoline strokes and wide gaps between neighbors, so paragraphs would read as modern, measured and spaced out.
gen-audiowide-work-sans: Futuristic and tech-minded, Audiowide sets tall lowercase like tiles with wide grout lines, with no thick-thin shift anywhere. Work Sans stays contemporary beside it, a plain sans with a high mean line.
gen-gf-offside-montserrat: Expressive and widely tracked, Offside holds a level beat with no accents of weight. And Montserrat glides in with oversized e and a counters, geometric and approachable where the heading is commanding.
gen-eater-manrope: Manrope reads approachable and clean, with a bright gap at every curved letter's mouth and a minimal step from caps to lowercase. Manrope would carry a long page smoothly, while Eater keeps its dark, widely spaced bite for the heading.
gen-flavors-satoshi: Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, every stroke cut to a single width in a plain sans. Flavors above it is whimsical and stubby.
